name: glyph-field
useFor: Put it behind the hero's code window (fade out, spilling past the card) or inside the closing card (fade in, gathering at the edges). Position it absolutely in a relative, isolated parent and keep it under the content.
constraints: More than three fields on a page
Blue as the main color of the field
A field on a dark ground
documentation:
`GlyphField` props: `seed` (another map, default 3), `fade` ("out" | "in" | "none", default out), plus canvas props.
Size it with classes; it redraws when its box changes. It flickers only while on screen and is still with reduced
motion.
title: Glyph field
description: A faint canvas field of *s and @s in clumps, with a few blue runs, that flickers while on screen.
